description: Use when enumerating and testing Kubernetes RBAC during an authorized cloud or cluster assessment, bug bounty engagement, or lab exercise. Covers cluster context, auth can-i checks, Role, ClusterRole, RoleBinding and ClusterRoleBinding enumeration, service account token abuse, secrets access, and dangerous bindings such as cluster-admin grants using kubectl 1.33 and Python 3.12. Use when you hold kubeconfig credentials for a test cluster and need to map privilege paths to cluster takeover.
